import Mathlib

theorem p07 (n : ℕ) (h : 3 ≤ n) : 2 * n < 2 ^ n := by
  induction n, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => norm_num
  | succ k hk ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega
